name: Memory Sequence
shortDescription: A classic memory game. Watch the sequence, then click the squares in the same order. How many rounds can you complete?
fullDescription: Memory Sequence is a brain-training memory game where you watch the computer highlight colored squares in a sequence, then repeat the pattern by clicking the squares. Each round adds a new color to the sequence, making it progressively harder. Test your memory and beat your high score!

generation.notes: Memory sequence game with 2x2 grid, progressively difficult rounds, high score persistence via localStorage, full mobile support, and smooth animations
